summary: Forum Markets, Inc. filed an 8-K to report its wholly-owned subsidiary, Eurus Aerospace Token I LLC, acquired a CFM56-7B aircraft engine from Aero Engine Solutions for $11.65 million in cash and simultaneously leased it to a major airline. The engine purchase is a routine asset acquisition and lease arrangement typical of the registrant's finance services business. No special-situation characteristics such as control changes, tenders, or strategic restructuring are present. The filing also includes a servicing agreement with purchase options but does not constitute a corporate event warranting special-situations classification.
